acceptanceCriteria: Owner decision recorded for each amendment; if accepted, the spec is amended and implemented with tests.
body: PR #1212 shipped V1-1945(b) opt-in only via obligations.requireDeclaredCites; making refusal the default needs an owner amendment of TOL-V0-079. Separately, the task store's own unborn HEAD still reads as stale; changing that needs a TOL-V0-077 amendment. Both are owner decisions; nothing was changed.
title: Owner question: make requireDeclaredCites the default (TOL-V0-079) and treat the store's own unborn HEAD as not stale (TOL-V0-077)?
